train_deit_model: train a DeiT vision transformer model on ImageNet with cosine LR scheduling and mixup augmentation
evaluate_deit_model: evaluate a trained DeiT model on a validation dataset and report top-1 accuracy
finetune_deit_with_pos_embed_interpolati: finetune a DeiT model from a pretrained checkpoint with bicubic position embedding interpolation
configure_distillation_training: configure knowledge distillation training with a teacher model using soft or hard distillation
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training with RASampler and DistributedDataParallel for DeiT models
